item.name: Naloxone_Nasal_Spray
item.description: NARCAN naloxone HCl nasal spray, 4 mg single-dose devices, with the current package directions.
item.readyBeforeUse: The package is sealed, unexpired, and not heat damaged.
item.readyForNextPerson: Unused devices remain sealed with the package directions and are protected from excessive heat and direct sunlight.
item.ifNotReady: Tell the Dominatrix to replace the package.

problem.condition: A device was used for a suspected opioid overdose.
problem.response: Get emergency help immediately, follow the package directions, stay with the person, and tell the Dominatrix that the used dose must be replaced.
